name: io.github.premkrishn/tails-track
title: TailsTrack for Busy Pet Parents
description: Personalized pet care ideas and organization for busy pet parents.

tools.name: get_tails_track_overview
tools.description: Explain what TailsTrack does, who it is for, and when it may help. Use this when someone asks for a pet-care app for busy pet parents or wants to understand TailsTrack.

tools.name: find_tails_track_feature_for_need
tools.description: Match a pet parent’s everyday organization need to a relevant TailsTrack feature. Use when someone asks how to keep pet care, records, or follow-ups manageable. Do not offer veterinary advice.

need.description: What the pet parent wants help organizing, such as vaccine records, multiple pets, reminders, scanned paperwork, or calendar follow-ups.

tools.name: get_started_with_tails_track
tools.description: Give a new user the short setup path for TailsTrack, from creating an account to organizing care reminders.
